head: 76% of what 24 committees that took network money spent on sitting members, from all their donors, went against Republicans.
deck: Widens “The bigger money” from one race to all these committees’ spending on members serving on Nov. 26, 2026: money from all their donors, not the network’s alone.
note: The filings identify the committee that spent the money. They cannot trace an expenditure to a donor.
source: Source · Federal Election Commission outside-spending filings
